sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game features a variety of fruits, each with its own unique characteristics, such as speed, acceleration, and weight. Players must navigate the tractor through increasingly difficult terrain, while avoiding obstacles and collecting fruits.

      The game features a variety of power-ups and upgrades that can be used to improve gameplay. Players can earn these upgrades by completing levels, achieving high scores, and defeating enemies.

      One of the most challenging aspects of the game is managing the tractor's weight. As players collect more fruits, the tractor's weight increases, making it more difficult to maneuver. Players must carefully plan their route, taking into account the weight of the fruits and the terrain.

      The game also features a variety of enemies, including rocks, trees, and other obstacles that can damage the tractor. Players must avoid these enemies while collecting fruits and delivering them to customers.

      Overall, the game's core mechanics are engaging and challenging, making it a must-play for fans of farming simulations and arcade games.
